# Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag

When Microsoft reported killer [fourth-quarter earnings](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/Investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q4/press-release-webcast) for its fiscal 2026 year (which ended June 30), it tucked in an interesting little tidbit about how its investments in the two biggest, and competing, AI labs are doing.

For the quarter, it recorded its investment in Anthropic [as a $3.2 billion gain](https://view.officeapps.live.com/op/view.aspx?src=https://microsoft.com/en-us/investor/earnings/FY-2026-Q4/Document/DownloadDocument/27/SlidesFY26Q4.pptx), boosting diluted earnings [er share by 33 cents. (Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $4.81 for the quarter). Microsoft invested $5 billion in Anthropic [in November 2025](https://blogs.microsoft.com/blog/2025/11/18/microsoft-nvidia-and-anthropic-announce-strategic-partnerships/) as part of a circular agreement under which the AI lab also agreed to buy $30 billion worth of Azure services.
